description: The validated research pipeline focuses on the apical four-chamber view and should not be generalized to other echocardiographic views without additional development and validation.
Automatic cardiac-cycle analysis and automatic ED/ES frame detection were not developed as part of the validated pipeline.
EDV and ESV are derived using a 2D single-plane area-length approximation rather than a full clinical biplane or 3D volumetric method.

Phase 2 and Phase 4 demonstrated that disagreement can exist between reference EF and EF derived even from GT-mask geometry; therefore downstream EF disagreement cannot always be attributed to segmentation alone.
Errors in LV segmentation and geometric measurements can propagate into volume and EF estimates.
Small continuous EF differences can change the categorical EF-band output when estimates lie near the predefined 40% or 50% boundaries.
Classifier confidence scores are uncalibrated, and Phase 4B identified confidently incorrect predictions. Confidence therefore cannot serve as a patient-level reliability guarantee.
Image-quality subgroup findings were descriptive, particularly because the Poor-quality subgroup contained only seven evaluation patients.
The system was developed and evaluated within the CAMUS-based research workflow. External clinical validation was not performed in the current project.
The application is an assistive research prototype and must not be presented as an autonomous diagnostic or treatment-decision system.
